$comment: ThieuNV Claude Code baseline — .claude/settings.json (project-level, shipped as-is by install.sh). This is the STRICT profile (the default); settings.relaxed.json is the relaxed variant selected via install.sh --profile. Rule syntax: 'Bash(x:*)' is a prefix match, a '*' anywhere else matches any text (NOT regex), matching is case-sensitive. Read/Edit use gitignore-style paths. Precedence: deny > ask > allow across every settings file — an ask rule prompts even when an allow rule also matches, and it applies when any part of a compound command matches. Permission modes: permissions.defaultMode acceptEdits runs file edits without prompts and the bare 'Bash' allow rule runs every Bash command no deny/ask rule names; in auto mode Claude Code drops that bare rule and a classifier decides instead. Either way the deny/ask lists plus the PreToolUse hooks are the only deterministic boundary (defaultMode is read ONLY inside permissions; a top-level key is ignored). Subagent model policy: hooks/agent-guard.sh blocks any subagent except Plan that would not run on Sonnet or Opus, Agent(fork) is denied because forks always run on the main model, and env CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet gives general-purpose/model-less custom agents a compliant default. Hook paths use ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} so every repo (including this one) is guarded. Dotenv policy lives in hooks/file-guard.sh (blocks all .env* except the placeholder templates .env.example/sample/template/dist — deny globs cannot express that exception); the bare .env deny rules here are defense-in-depth. The .claude/* self-edit denies keep the agent from neutralizing its own guard layer (file-guard and bash-guard rule 14 are the deterministic backstop). Verify rules after install with /permissions inside Claude Code.
$comment-ask: Ask by action, not by tool (v2.13.0): docker, the SQL clients, redis-cli, kubectl, helm, aws, gcloud, az and systemctl prompt only for the listed data- or state-changing actions (the SQL and redis rules start with '*' so they also match 'docker exec <container> psql …'; they see SQL written inline after the client name, in upper or lower case — SQL piped in, read from a file or sent through a heredoc is not asked about). Read-only and run/build commands are not listed, and neither is anything the lists do not know: those are left to the permission mode. Destructive commands (DROP, TRUNCATE, volume rm, FLUSHALL, rm -rf, …) never reach these rules: hooks/bash-guard.sh blocks them. tests/settings-profile-test.sh generates this list from the action families and fails on any drift, so change both together.
$comment-scope: Outside directories (v2.13.0, needs Claude Code 2.1.314+): a path outside the project is refused until the user grants its directory with /add-dir (one grant lasts the session). blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories makes Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse it; hooks/scope-guard.sh blocks it in Bash commands and, since v2.13.1, in Read, Grep and Glob, and records each /add-dir through the DirectoryAdded event in ~/.claude/avn-scope/ (deny-listed for edits and blocked in Bash, so the obvious ways for the agent to grant itself are closed). Do NOT set blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories (v2.13.0 did): with it Claude Code prompts in every mode for each Bash command whose paths it cannot trace ('cd sub && ls', a loop, '$(...)', 'find | xargs', 'python3 -c'), even when the command stays inside the project. Inside ~/.claude only CLAUDE.md, rules, skills, agents, commands, plans, output-styles and this project's own folder under projects/ are open without a grant; the file tools also reach plugins/ and the .md files at its top. Worktrees are banned (v2.13.0): the EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree tools, 'git worktree add' and Agent isolation are denied, and the WorktreeCreate hook fails every other route (--worktree, background sessions, agent definitions).
$comment-env: CLAUDE_AFK_TIMEOUT_MS disables the 60s AskUserQuestion auto-advance ('AFK mode') introduced unannounced in Claude Code v2.1.198, which made interview flows (/brainstorm) proceed without the user's answer. Undocumented var (github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/73125); versions without AFK ignore it harmlessly. If your Claude Code exposes a question-timeout toggle in /config, keep it OFF. CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet is the default model for subagents that neither pass a model nor pin one in their definition (general-purpose, model-less custom agents); the built-in Explore ignores it and must be given model explicitly. hooks/agent-guard.sh enforces the policy either way.
$comment-attribution: Empty strings switch off the Co-Authored-By commit trailer and the pull-request attribution line (v2.12.0). Keep the OBJECT form: attribution=false needs Claude Code v2.1.281+, and an older version that meets it skips this whole file, dropping every rule and hook.
$comment-plugins: Websites and landing pages are built with the design-taste-frontend skill of the taste-skill plugin (github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT; needs Node 22+ and Chrome). The marketplace registers after the workspace trust dialog, but a plugin enabled only in project settings is not fetched automatically — each developer runs once: claude plugin install taste-skill@taste-skill --scope user. Opt out in one checkout with "taste-skill@taste-skill": false under enabledPlugins in .claude/settings.local.json.

hooks.command: echo 'BLOCKED by baseline policy: git worktrees are disabled. Work in the current checkout and create a branch there (git checkout -b).' >&2; exit 2
